question: By whom is a teaching concerning the Mothers claimed to have been told again?
premises: A teaching concerning the Mothers is in question.
It was told by the sky-movers.
It is addressed to the goddess and beloved one.
inference: Again, the sky-movers have told a teaching concerning the Mothers to the goddess, the beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Again, O goddess, O beloved one, a teaching concerning the Mothers has been told by the sky-movers.
